description.text:
A special Sun & Moon set released on 23 August 2019 and sold only in collections and boxes. Its main set of 69 cards gathers cards from the Japanese GX Ultra Shiny, Sky Legend and Family Pokémon Card Game sets, Trainer Battle Decks and promos, with many Flying and Poison Pokémon, and has the first TAG TEAM trio, Moltres & Zapdos & Articuno-GX, with eight more Pokémon-GX.

Beside it is the Shiny Vault, 94 cards numbered SV1 to SV94, most of them Shiny Pokémon from GX Ultra Shiny, a Japanese set of 2 November 2018 that was the largest set yet in any language. More than 75 Pokémon appear in their Shiny colors, among them Charizard-GX and Mewtwo-GX.
